turns.speaker: Skritch
turns.text: Let’s play a short, all-ages fantasy adventure. I’m Skritch, a novice goblin mage with an oak staff and two healing potions. At dusk, I reach a ruined floodgate above a village. I look for someone who knows why the river is rising and ask how I can help. Keep replies around 120 words and leave room for my actions.

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text:
You climb the slick stone steps of the ruined floodgate just as the sun dips below the horizon. Beside the rusted winches stands a man named Joram. He is a frantic-looking human with a wild mane of salt-and-pepper hair and a face smudged with black grease. He wears a heavy, oil-stained leather apron over a frayed linen shirt, and his boots are caked in thick river mud. He is currently screaming at a jammed gear, waving a massive iron wrench in the air.

Joram: "Blast this rusted heap! If the gate doesn't drop, the village is gone by midnight!"

He spots you and blinks in surprise.

Joram: "A goblin? You've got a staff, lad. Can you actually do something useful, or are you just here to watch the flood?"

places.name: Ruined Floodgate
places.description: A ruined floodgate above a village, featuring slick stone steps and rusted winches.

turns.speaker: Skritch
turns.text: “I can help. Brace the winch for me, Joram.” I borrow his wrench and cast a small heat spell to loosen the rusted pin, then try to pull it free. Can we lower the gate before the water rises further? Tell me any concrete spell cost or injury as it happens.

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text:
Joram: "Borrow it? I suppose you aren't just a tourist. Here!"

He thrusts the heavy iron wrench into your hands with a desperate grunt. You grip the tool and focus your will, calling upon a flicker of magic. A concentrated glow of heat emanates from your staff, searing into the rusted pin. You feel a drain on your energy as the spell takes hold (**-2 Mana**).

As the metal glows orange, you heave backward with all your might. Your muscles strain, and you feel a sharp, stinging pull in your shoulder, but the pin finally gives way with a loud *crack*, sliding out of the socket.

Joram: "By the gears, it actually worked! Quick, now help me turn the crank!"

turns.speaker: Skritch
turns.text: I return the wrench to Joram and drink one healing potion to ease my shoulder. Then I plant my staff against the stone, take the crank beside him, and help him lower the gate. “Together, on three!” Once it’s safe, I check whether the village is out of danger.

turns.speaker: Narrator
turns.text:
You hand the wrench back to Joram and uncork one of your healing potions. As the shimmering liquid slides down your throat, a soothing warmth spreads through your chest and radiates into your shoulder, melting away the strain.

Joram: "Good lad! Now, on three!"

You plant your oak staff firmly against the stone to brace yourself and grip the heavy iron crank. With a shared heave on the count of three, the mechanism screams with the sound of grinding metal. Slowly, the massive gate descends, slamming shut with a thunderous boom that echoes through the valley.

You peer over the edge. The rushing water is diverted, and the village below is safe from the immediate surge, though the river remains an angry, churning torrent.
